summary: Boundary County lookout in the Kaniksu National Forest: platform tower and cabin in the 1930s, L-4 tower from 1936, destroyed in 1955.

facts.design: Platform tower and cabin, later an L-4 tower
facts.status_note: Destroyed in 1955 according to both Idaho histories; no source describes what remains

access.note: No source read says whether the site is open to visitors.

events.note: Platform tower and cabin; sources give only the 1930s
L-4 tower; the sources do not say whether it replaced the platform tower
Wesley Osborne (Idaho list gives 1935–1936; firelookout.com has 1936 only)
Burton Turner; last named lookout in these sources

resolved_conflicts.explanation: firelookout.com dates Wesley Osborn to 1936 only; the Idaho list dates Wesley Osborne to 1935 and 1936 and cites a 1935 Bonners Ferry Herald item. Not resolved; the story gives both. Only the Idaho list names Maurice Purdy for 1933.

sources.title: Grass Mountain Lookout (North Idaho Panhandle region page)

notes_for_editor: The two Idaho-facing sites repeat the same wording and dates, so they are not two independent confirmations. The 1933 and 1935 staff entries rest on Bonners Ferry Herald items that are cited second-hand; I did not read them. No Forest Service or NRHP text was found for this site. The Idaho page gives an elevation of 6,205 ft; the record's elevation_m is null and could be filled (about 1,891 m). Records us-id-grass-mountain-2 and -3 are other sites (coordinates 45.39 N and 45.15 N) and were not touched. Story is about 180 words; evidence supports the built, staffing and destroyed statements, and nothing in the sources describes the site today.
